requiredProfileExpectations.demand: A requires prior attraction/repulsion and quarter-factor predictions, both SI-valued signed force components in both configurations, interaction-pair/inverse-square explanation, stationary sources, medium-specific k and point-charge limits. All are explicit mandatory full-credit components.

A derives signed E from F2/q2 and transfers to a new positive charge. Independent B separately infers a different source field from opposite-sign probes, predicts a new negative-probe force and rejects/corrects an inconsistent datum.

observedTaskCases: A two-charge geometry with force-to-field transfer
B a fresh fixed source configuration inferred from separately supplied forces
independentDemonstrations.interpretation: Matches the full P application briefs: A tests Coulomb/vector application; B is the independently transferred field inference. No claim that B reconstructs unknown source geometry.

assessments.fairness: Equivalent vector sketches and valid methods accepted. 0.675 microN rounded to 0.68 microN remains full credit at the supplied two-significant-figure scale. Harmless slips and corrected arithmetic are explicitly distinguished from wrong directions, missing SI consistency or missing core work.

requiredProfileExpectations.demand: A prospective contrast question, personal safe paper setup, actual calibrated centre spacing/width/gap and eye-reference distance, fixed bright-gap rule, random presentation/distance ordering and single-bar controls precede both own measurement series.

Both series require individual own responses, >=3 distances with 5 pair trials each, >=5 controls, 5 fresh near-threshold trials, bounded threshold/geometry propagation, observed frequencies and random/systematic distinction; both actual angular ranges are quantitatively compared to external 1.22 lambda/D and its D variation with explicit point/line, wavelength and causal limits.

observedTaskCases: B independently presented/answered lower-contrast series with unchanged geometry/light/correction/criterion

assessments.practicality: Ordinary matte paper, measured printed dimensions, a ruler/tape and optional helper/magnification suffice for a bounded school experiment. At s=0.6mm, angles 2e-4 to 5e-4 rad correspond to 3.0 to 1.2m. Minimum 50 pair/control presentations across both conditions (15 pairs+5 controls+5 near-repeat pairs per condition) is finite and feasible as a practical assignment. A helper improves concealment; the stated self-run limitation prevents a false blinding claim. This is a desk feasibility judgment, not observed execution.
assessments.fairness: No prescribed measured angle or forced contrast difference. Unexpected frequencies, overlapping A/B intervals and a genuinely unresolved sharp threshold can earn full credit after real appropriate controls and an honest wider range. Examples and D=3mm cannot replace actual work; D is not the learner pupil. A tiny sample is explicitly not a confidence interval or medical test.

independentDeskGrading.note: Each expanded synthetic answer has all criterion scores and specific reasons, including cross-criterion contradictions. These are independent semantic judgments, not subtraction of a criterion maximum. No real learner or eye measurements were performed.
